title: Synchronized Solutions for Liouville Systems with Sign-Changing Coefficients
summary: We consider singular Liouville systems on closed Riemann surfaces with a common sign-changing coefficient. Direct continuation from a positive coefficient is obstructed by the unavoidable appearance of degenerate zeroes along such a homotopy. We instead identify an intrinsic ray in the parameter space on which the system admits synchronized solutions and reduces exactly to a scalar sign-changing mean-field equation.
